The owner's standing order since 2026-11-11 is "NÃO USE AGENTES": I read, design, code, test and photograph myself. No subagent,
no fork, no new session, unless the owner's own message orders them; never send SendMessage to an agent that has stopped,
finished or been cancelled (it resumes it, and that counts as launching one).

**Why:** credit cost and quality. 2026-11-09 the owner forbade opening or resuming any agent and cancelled three; the same day a
13-agent fan-out burned credits ("PARE DE MANDAR TANTOS AGENTES. VOCÊ É QUE TEM QUE REALIZAR O TRABALHO"); 2026-11-11, again,
"NÃO USE AGENTES", repeated in the /goal.

**How to apply:** do the work myself, reading whole files personally ([[read-before-delegating]]). If the owner ever orders
agents in a message, a handful at most, sized and said before launch, never topped up. Related: [[coordinate-parallel-sessions]].
